title: The aim
text: You are thieves in a dragon's dungeon. Go down, take one Artifact, and get back out alive. Treasure is points. Whoever has the most at the end wins, provided they lived or at least reached the upper levels.

title: Your deck
text:
Everyone starts with the same ten weak cards. Each turn you play all five cards in your hand, then draw five more. Cards give three things: Skill to buy better cards, Swords to fight monsters, and Boots to move.

Cards you buy go to your discard pile and come round when your deck is reshuffled. This also works with the Catacombs box, which builds its dungeon from tiles as you explore.

title: Moving
text: Each Boot moves you along one tunnel. A tunnel with footprints costs two Boots. A tunnel with monsters costs a Sword for each, or a wound for each you cannot pay. Locked tunnels need a key. Entering a crystal cave ends your movement for the turn.

title: Clank
text: Some cards make noise. When one says so, put that many of your cubes in the Clank area. Noise is how the dragon finds you.

title: The dragon attacks
text:
When a new card with the dragon symbol comes into the row, the dragon attacks. All cubes in the Clank area go into the bag, and cubes are drawn out: the dragon's rage track says how many. Each cube of your colour is a wound.

The dragon grows angrier each time an Artifact is taken.

title: Getting out
text:
You may carry one Artifact. Once you have it, head for the surface. The first player out earns a bonus, and from then on that player's turns are dragon attacks, so the rest have only a few rounds left.

If your health track fills you are knocked out. Above the depths with an Artifact, you are rescued and still score. Otherwise you score nothing.

title: What I do not carry
text: The values of the treasures and the text of the cards are on the cards and in your rulebook. I will keep the turn order.
